evidence.reason: The caught error is passed directly to isPreRequestCeilingRefusal at src/driver/ai-sdk/index.ts:1416, and the branch reads err.kind at line 1417. With maxRetries: 1, a retryable first attempt followed by a pre-request ceiling refusal can be thrown by the SDK as a RetryError, so the guard does not see the inner refusal. Budget refusals can then fall through to the generic path and settle as error/unknown, while harness refusals lose their diagnostic class. The RetryError must be unwrapped before both the guard and branch-body reads.
